subject: LINE clause
notes: kb/Work PB1188: a line of a paged report placed below the page limit is the group split between two pages; EC-REPORT-PAGE-LIMIT is set and, raised, the rest of the group is abandoned (resume at the next report group). The golden: DE-L lines 2..7 on a 6-line page lose L6, the next detail goes to the next page. With checking off the line prints below the limit (results undefined).
